summary: On MARA's plans page, all developers get $5 of free credit to start testing and building with MARA Inference Service, and initial credits expire in 30 days. The Free plan lists $5 in free API credits, access to production models, and no credit card required to start. The Developer plan is pay as you go for token usage, and you add a card when credits run out. The page says the credit translates to millions of tokens on leading open-source models.
claim_steps: Open cloud.mara.com/plans and choose Get Started on the Free plan
Sign up; no credit card is required

social_proof.title: Plan and Billing
